tips:
## Narrative Structure

### Story Openings
Hebrew stories often begin with:
- **פעם** -- Once / Once upon a time
- **היה היה** (masculine) / **הייתה הייתה** (feminine) -- Once there was
- **לפני שנים רבות** -- Many years ago

Example: **היה היה מלך** שגר בארמון גדול. -- Once there was a king who lived in a big palace.

### Story Progression
| Hebrew | English | Use |
|---|---|---|
| ואז | and then | Sequence |
| לפתע | suddenly | Surprise twist |
| באותו רגע | at that moment | Dramatic pause |
| אחר כך | after that | Next event |

### Story Endings
- **בסופו של דבר** -- In the end / Eventually
- **וכך נגמר הסיפור** -- And so the story ended
- **והם חיו באושר ובעושר** -- And they lived happily and richly (Hebrew "happily ever after")

### Key Vocabulary
- **סיפור** (story) --> **סיפורים** (stories)
- **עלילה** (plot) -- what happens in the story
- **דמות** (character/figure) --> **דמויות** (characters)
- **גיבור** (hero) -- the main character

### Note on היה היה
This doubled form is unique to storytelling. In everyday speech you would simply say **היה** (there was).
